text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On the way back from an outing with Nakayama Festa—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, you.
Do you... know much about amusement parks?
choice_data_list: What's gotten into you all of a sudden?
What's the matter all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: My little tyke... my little sister's coming over to visit.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: And apparently, my mom gave me tickets to an amusement park.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Mother
text_block_list.text: "—So take her with you! Listen to me, just don't go doing anything dangerous, you hear?!"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Haa.
I've never made the squirt do something like that.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Mother
text_block_list.text: "‘You too!! Think about how worried I was! Besides, that girl is always copying you right away!’"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
…………
...Yeah, yeah.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: So that's how it is.
choice_data_list: So you want to scout it out beforehand, huh?
So you want to check it out in advance, huh?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Well, that's about the gist of it.
Ugh, what a drag...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With no reason to refuse if that was the case,
we decided to head straight to the amusement park.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"There are still people around even at this hour.
...Somehow, this atmosphere... brings back memories."
choice_data_list: Has it been a while since you last came here?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"That's exactly why we're scouting it out.
For now, let's just wander around a bit."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Well, it's peaceful, that's for sure.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Our safety's guaranteed, so there's
no reason to pull any dangerous stunts out here.
choice_data_list: Don't you have a favorite attraction or anything, Nakayama?
Don't you have a favorite attraction, Nakayama?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Not really... If that had been there, I probably would've visited a bit more often.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
When I was brought here as a kid,
all I did was ride roller coasters and go into haunted houses, though.
choice_data_list: Your little sister would be happy too, I'm sure.
Your little sister would love that too, wouldn't she.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If she's trying to imitate Nakayama Festa,
she must like things
that give her a thrill.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"...Maybe so.
Now then, next up is..."

text_block_list.name: Broadcast
text_block_list.text:
"—Thank you for visiting us today.
As closing time approaches—"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Tsk. Got here too late, huh?
Looks like I can still catch at least one more, though...
choice_data_list: I guess it has to be the haunted house.
When you think amusement parks, you think roller coasters!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
It's getting dark, so
the atmosphere's setting in nicely.
Let's go.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Well, not bad.
The build is detailed, and the scare tactics are decent enough.
With this, she'll probably—
Kyaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Whoa, what's going on...?!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, aaah...!!
Nakayama-san, thank, thank goodness...!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"...Falcon?
What are you doing in a place like this?"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"...U-Um, like getting fired up before a live,
I thought it'd give me way more courage and guts...
B-But... but, still...!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I-I managed to make it this far,
but going any further is impossible... NO WAY!!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...That much?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
It really is that bad!!
A blood-soaked countess,
a giant creature wrapped in bandages...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: And on top of that, it's trying to chase after me!?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Heeh, sounds interesting.
I'll be sure to keep a close eye on it.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
No way!! It's way too scary... Something like that
might make my heart jump right out of my chest
and fly away, you know?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa acts completely unfazed.
However, with that much terror awaiting her,
no matter how much she's trying to imitate her sister—
choice_data_list: Aren't you being a little hard on your sister...?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Ah... Right.
That's what we were scouting ahead for.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Her little sister!? Unless she's as fearless
as you, Nakayama-san,
I'm pretty sure she's gonna end up crying...!?"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Hah. Better steer clear of this one.
It'll be a pain if she starts crying on me.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
For now, let's just enjoy what's ahead.
...Don't disappoint me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, I took Smart Falcon and ventured deeper inside.
Nakayama Festa seemed to have thoroughly enjoyed the haunted house.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Well, it's certainly a thrill that's easy to enjoy.
Alright, let's go.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
It's completely different from running on your own feet...!
And to ride standing up, no less!
Aah, it was fun, but so scary~!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... That's true.
With all the spinning and the height, I could feel
an atmosphere you just can't experience on the track.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
If I could run like that...
I wonder how wonderful it would feel—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Oh? You guys came too?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ah, Nakayama-san! Hello there.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...I see, so it's for your sister.
You're so kind, Nakayama.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: They just dumped all the trouble on me...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! I'm sure your little sister
will enjoy the roller coaster too.
You should definitely take her on it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I shift my gaze to the roller coaster's entrance.
There stands a height measurement board—"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"It was just like... *whoosh*!
She was going so fast, I thought she was gonna fly away somewhere—"
choice_data_list: Looks like there's a height restriction.
Looks like there's a height restriction.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Flying... somewhere...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Not tall enough for a shorty like me.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Aaaah! I'm sorry,
you really shouldn't let them on board—!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: It might be thrilling, sure, but if you don't follow the rules, it's genuinely dangerous...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Spe-chan, calm down...
Nakayama knows that too.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Guess I'll hop on.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Ha, just kidding.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Enjoying danger is my exclusive trademark.
...Ain't gonna let a squirt like you do it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Saying so, we headed toward the roller coaster.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The sheer speed and steep drops... It was quite the thrill, and Nakayama Festa seemed to genuinely enjoy her first amusement park visit in a while.
